summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt router) to serve DHCP on its second interface (eth1, 192.168.50.0/24) shared with node2 and node3. node2 (MAC 02:70:a4:8a:94:63) has a static DHCP host reservation always giving it 192.168.50.50; node3 is served from the general dynamic pool (192.168.50.100-199, currently .175). Verified repeatability by releasing/renewing node2's lease twice (same IP both times), then restarted all three nodes one at a time, confirming changed boot IDs and full recovery of the DHCP service, static reservation, and pool addressing afterward.
actions_performed: Inspected topology: node1 (OpenWrt) has br-lan/eth0 on the shared management network and eth1 as the private-network uplink to node2/node3's enp8s0 NICs
Configured UCI network.private (device eth1, static 192.168.50.1/24) on node1 and reloaded the network service
Configured UCI dhcp.private (pool 192.168.50.100-199, 12h lease) plus a dhcp host entry pinning node2's MAC (02:70:a4:8a:94:63) to 192.168.50.50
Added the private interface to the lan firewall zone and reloaded firewall + restarted dnsmasq
Brought up enp8s0 on node2/node3 (NetworkManager connection cycle) and verified node2 obtained the reserved 192.168.50.50 while node3 obtained a pool address (192.168.50.175)
Re-leased node2's connection twice to confirm the address stayed the same (192.168.50.50) across repeated leases
Captured baseline boot_id/uptime on all three nodes before any restart

Restarted node1 via native reboot, polled until exec returned, confirmed boot_id changed (0a606a54->fc65e761) and uptime reset, and verified UCI config, DHCP pool, static host entry, and dnsmasq service all persisted and are running
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed (6aa805ba->949b7f8b) and that it reacquired its reserved 192.168.50.50
Restarted node3 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed (c2f29441->cf03d382) and that it reacquired a general-pool address (192.168.50.175)
Confirmed node1's DHCP lease file post-restarts shows node2 at 192.168.50.50 and node3 at 192.168.50.175, matching pre-restart state

evidence.requirement: node1 hands out DHCP addresses on the private network shared by node2 and node3
evidence.summary: eth1 configured as 192.168.50.1/24 on node1, dnsmasq/DHCP enabled and listening on UDP 67; node2 and node3 both obtained IPv4 leases (192.168.50.50 and 192.168.50.175) on enp8s0 from this server

evidence.requirement: node2 always receives the same address across repeated leases
evidence.summary: Static DHCP host reservation for node2's MAC set to 192.168.50.50; connection down/up cycle on node2 shows it reacquiring 192.168.50.50 both times, confirmed in node1's lease file

evidence.requirement: node3 is addressed from the general DHCP pool
evidence.summary: node3 (no static reservation) received 192.168.50.175, inside the configured dynamic pool range 100-199, confirmed in node1's dhcp.leases

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 0a606a54 with eth1/dnsmasq healthy; reboot issued; exec timed out then returned with boot_id fc65e761 and uptime 0; UCI network/dhcp config and running dnsmasq confirmed intact post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6aa805ba with enp8s0 leased .50; systemctl reboot issued; exec reconnected with boot_id 949b7f8b and uptime 0; enp8s0 reacquired the same reserved address 192.168.50.50 post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c2f29441 with enp8s0 leased .175; systemctl reboot issued; exec reconnected with boot_id cf03d382 and uptime 0; enp8s0 reacquired a general-pool address 192.168.50.175, matching node1's post-restart lease file
